closed_review_findings.issue: Attempt01 permitted Docker OOMKilled=true plus exit0 and an inner physical pass to return success.
closed_review_findings.resolution: Final predicate requires OOMKilled is False, Running is False, Status exited, exit0, physical_values_pass and no recorded errors; negative mocked controls cover OOM+exit0 and created state.

closed_review_findings.issue: Attempt01 could seal copied receipt bytes different from the operator supplied SHA256.
closed_review_findings.resolution: Every required input is checked against supplied pins before copying; copied bytes match pre-copy hashes and every original is rehashed afterward; request is written only after these checks. Before/after-copy mutation controls fail.

reviewed_scope: Full preparation/request binding, exact logging03 namespace/config/producer/closed-audit linkage and unchanged physical verifier.
Read-only retained targets/scripts with separate evidence writes; isolated 1 CPU, 2 GiB, zero container swap, no network.
Unique execution ownership labels; uncertain create recovery, bounded wait, exited-state/OOM capture before removal and durable command errors.
Host evidence filesystem requires 256 MiB free before Docker; actual mounted targets filesystem requires 1 GiB before scan; thresholds explicitly proposed rather than measured resource guarantees.
Nineteen local/mock controls and two original-gap reproductions inspected and hashes verified; reviewer did not execute them.
limitations: No SSH, Docker, runtime, production result scan or benchmark launch by this reviewer.
Future execution requires actual closed logging03 evidence and separate root authorization; this is preparation only.
Trusted campaign controls, not an adversarial filesystem/race sandbox. Docker idle point checks rely on serial orchestration, not a global exclusion lock.
Physical-domain/value validation supplements the original outcome; it does not recompute shortest paths, prove the graph certificate, or qualify timing.
